senses.gloss: मधव्य m. The lunar month Vaiśākha.
मधु (I) a. (f. धु, धू or ध्वी) Sweet, pleasant, agreeable.

मधु (II) m. 1. The month of Chaitra, भास्करस्य मधुमाधवाविव R.xi.7, मासे मधौ मधुरकोकिलभृंगनादै रामा हरंति हृदयं प्रसभं नराणाम् Rt.vi.25; 2. the spring season, सहायमेकं मधुमेव लब्ध्वा K.S.iii.10, 30; 3. the Aśoka tree; 4. name of a demon killed by Viṣṇu; 5. name of another demon killed by Śatrughna; 6. an epithet of king Kārtavīrya.
मधु (III) n. 1. Honey, M.ii.29; 2. spirituous liquor, प्रियामुखोच्छ्वासविकल्पितं मधु Rt.i.3, विनयंते स्म तद्योधा मधुभिर्विजयश्रमम् R.iv.65; 3. the nectar of flowers; 4. sugar; 5. sweetness; 6. water.

मध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. Middle, being in the middle, intervening, intermediate, Megh.i.46; 2. of a middle kind, of a middling size or quantity, moderate; 3. neutral, impartial; 4. just, reasonable.

मध्य (II) m.n. 1. The middle, तिष्ठत्येष क्षणमधिपतिर्ज्योतिषां व्योममध्ये Vikr.ii., Bg.i.21; 2. the interior of anything; 3. the waist, मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या K.S.i.39, मध्ये क्षामा चकितहरिणीप्रेक्षणा निम्ननाभिः Megh.ii.19; 4. the belly, abdomen, K.S.i.39; 5. the flank of a horse; 6. pause, interval, R.xii.29; 7. the middle term of a progression.

मध्य (III) n. Ten thousand billions.(मध्यम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘into the midst, in, into,’ मध्येन in the sense of ‘through or between,’ and मध्यात् in the sense of ‘out of, from among, from the midst.’)
मध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. Middle, being in the middle, intervening, intermediate, Megh.i.46; 2. of a middle kind, of a middling size or quantity, moderate; 3. neutral, impartial; 4. just, reasonable.

मध्य-देश m. 1. the middle part of anything; 2. the waist; 3. the belly; 4. the meridian; 5. the country lying between the Himālaya and the Vindhya mountains.
मध्य-पदलोपिन् m. the same as मध्यमपदलोपिन् q.v.
मध्य-पात m. intercourse, commerce.

मध्य-स्थल n. 1. the centre; 2. a middle place; 3. the waist.
मध्य-स्थान n. 1. a neutral soil; 2. a middle place.

मध्यम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Middle, central, placed in the middle; 2. middling, moderate, तेन मध्यमशक्तीनि मित्राणि स्थापितान्यतः R.xvii.58; 3. intermediate, intervening, ययौ मध्यमलोकपालः R.ii.16, पितुः पदं मध्यममुत्पतंती Vikr.i., क्रांतं येन क्षपिततमसा मध्यमं धाम विष्णोः Sak.iv.; 4. neutral, impartial; 5. middle-born, i.e. neither the oldest nor the youngest, (e.g. मध्यमपांडव).

मध्यम (II) m. 1. The midland country; 2. the second person (in gram.); 3. name of the fourth note of the Hindu gamut; 4. the governor of a province; 5. a neutral sovereign, धर्मोत्तरं मध्यममाश्रयंते R.xiii.7.
मध्यम (III) n. The middle, waist.

मध्यम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Middle, central, placed in the middle; 2. middling, moderate, तेन मध्यमशक्तीनि मित्राणि स्थापितान्यतः R.xvii.58; 3. intermediate, intervening, ययौ मध्यमलोकपालः R.ii.16, पितुः पदं मध्यममुत्पतंती Vikr.i., क्रांतं येन क्षपिततमसा मध्यमं धाम विष्णोः Sak.iv.; 4. neutral, impartial; 5. middle-born, i.e. neither the oldest nor the youngest, (e.g. मध्यमपांडव).
मध्यमा f. 1. A girl arrived at puberty; 2. the middle finger; 3. the pericarp of a lotus; 4. a woman in the middle of her youth considered as a character in poetic composition.
माध्यम a. (f. मी) Relating to the middle, middle-most, central.
मध्यम-अंगुलि f. the middle finger.
मध्यम-आहरण n. the elimination of the middle term in an equation (in algebra).
मध्यम-कक्षा f. the middle court-yard.
मध्यम-जात a. middle-born.
मध्यम-पद n. the middle member (of a compound word).
मध्यम-पद˚लोपिन् m. a compound word which omits the middle member in its composition, (e.g. शाकपार्थिव where the word प्रिय between शाक and पार्थिव is omitted).
मध्यम-पांडव m. an epithet of Arjuna.
मध्यम-पुरुष m. the second person (in gram.).
मध्यम-भृतक m. a cultivator who works both for himself and for his landlord.
मध्यम-रात्र m. midnight.
मध्यम-रेखा f. the central meridian of the earth.
मध्यम-लोक m. the middle world, i.e. the earth.
मध्यम-लोक˚पाल m. a king, R.ii.16.
मध्यम-वयस् n. middle age.
मध्यम-वयस्क a. middle-aged.
मध्यम-संग्रह m. intrigue of a middling character; (प्रेषणं गंधमाल्यानां धूपभूषणवाससाम् । प्रलोभनं चान्नपानेर्मध्यमः संग्रहो मतः).
मध्यम-साहस (I) m. the second of the three penalties (in law). See M.viii.138.
मध्यम-साहस (II) m.n. violence of the middle class.
मध्यमक a. (f. मिका) Middlemost.
माध्यमक a. (f. मिका) Relating to the middle, middle-most.
मध्यमक a. (f. मिका) Middlemost.
मध्यमिका f. A girl arrived at puberty.
माध्यमक a. (f. मिका) Relating to the middle, middle-most.
माध्यमिक a. (f. की) Relating to the middle, middle-most.
मध्ये ind. 1. In the middle, in the midst; 2. within, in.
मध्ये-गंगम् ind. into the Ganges.
मध्ये-नगरम् ind. inside the city.
मध्ये-नदि ind. in the middle of the river.
मध्ये-पृष्ठम् ind. on the back.
मध्ये-भक्त n. a medicine to be taken whilst eating.
मध्ये-सभम् ind. at an assembly, before an assembly, Na.vi.76.
मध्व m. Name of the founder of a sect of Vaishṇavas. He has written a Bhāshya on the Vedāntasūtra, like Śankara and Rāmānuja.
माध्व (I) a. (f. ध्वी) Sweet.
माध्व (II) m. A follower of Madhva.
मध्वक m. A bee.
माध्वक n. A beverage prepared from honey.
मध्विजा f. Any intoxicating beverage.
माधव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Made of honey; 2. vernal; 3. belonging to the descendants of Madhu.

माधव (II) m. 1. An epithet of Kṛṣṇa, यावदर्थपदां वाचमेवमादाय माधवः Sis.ii.13, Bg.i.14; 2. the spring season, स माधवेनाभिमतेन सख्या रत्या च साशंकमनुप्रयातः K.S.iii.23; 3. the month of Vaiśākha, भास्करस्य मधुमाधवाविव R.xi.7; 4. an epithet of Paraśurāma; 5. of Indra; 6. name of a celebrated scholar, supposed by some to be identical with Śāyaṇa; but he tells us that his father’s name was Māyaṇa and that he had two brothers Śāyaṇa and Bhoganātha; he flourished in the middle of the fourteenth century, and has left works on almost every branch of Sanskrit literature.
माधव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Made of honey; 2. vernal; 3. belonging to the descendants of Madhu.
माधवी f. 1. A sacred basil; 2. a kind of creeper with fragrant flowers, प्रत्यासन्नो कुरबकवृतेर्माधवीमंडपस्य Megh.ii.15; 3. a kind of spirituous liquor; 4. a procuress, a bawd.
माधव-श्री f. the beauty of spring.
माधवक m.n. A kind of spirituous liquor.
माधविका f. Name of a creeper, माधविकापरिमलललिते नवमालतिजातिसुगंधौ Git.G.i.
माधवीय a. (f. या) Relating to Mādhava.
माधवीय a. (f. या) Relating to Mādhava.
माधुकरी f. 1. Gathering alms from door to door as a bee gathers honey from flower to flower; 2. alms obtained from five different places.
माधुरी f. 1. Sweetness, sweet taste, वंद्यैव माधुरीयं पंडितराजस्य कवितायाः Bh.V.iv.43, सा बिंबाधरमाधुरी Git.G.iii.; 2. a kind of spirituous liquor.

माधुर्य n. 1. Sweetness, gracefulness; 2. sweetness of composition considered as a Guṇa in rhetoric, (चित्तद्रवीभावमयो ह्रादो माधुर्यमुच्यते); 3. exquisite beauty or lovelineee, (रूपं किमप्वनिर्वाच्यं तनोर्माधुर्यमुच्यते).
माध्यम a. (f. मी) Relating to the middle, middle-most, central.
माध्यस्थ n. 1. Neutrality; 2. impartiality; 3. indifference, माध्यस्थ्यमिष्टेऽप्यवलंबतेर्थे K.S.i.52; 4. mediation, intercession.
माध्याह्निक a. (f. की) Relating to midday.
माध्याह्निक a. (f. की) Relating to midday.
माध्वीक n. 1. A kind of liquor distilled from the blossoms of the Madhūka tree, चचाम मधु माध्वीकम् Bt.xiv.94; 2. a grape.
माध्वीक-फल n. a species of cocoanut.
माध्यमिक a. (f. की) Relating to the middle, middle-most.
